title: NPDev External AI Pack
description: The redacted, chunked artefact actually sent to an external AI (ADR-0009). Built by the platform producer (scripts/external-review/build-review-pack.py, git-pinned) or the product's in-app producer (com.finalexec.review) -- the P6 conformance test requires both to emit a byte-identical pack for the same input. This is the only egress path; its manifest hash is what a verdict and a run record both point back to.

source.description: Where the pack's content was pulled from -- a platform pack is git-pinned; a product pack is an app's own model/generated code; a generated-app pack (REG-51) slices a generated FinalApp's own emitted output (e.g. mission M1/M7), which is a DIFFERENT commit's output than the platform repo's HEAD and must record its own provenance rather than being conflated with platform-git.

repo.description: platform-git: repo-relative identity, e.g. NPDev_General. generated-app: the absolute path the app's emitted code was sliced from.

commit.description: platform-git only: the pinned git revision (git show <rev>:<path>) -- required so a calibration mission can target a pre-fix parent commit.

appId.description: product-app only: the generated app this pack was built from.

modelVersion.description: product-app only: the app model version/hash the pack was built against.

generatedAtUtc.description: generated-app only: this generated app's own npdev-build-info.properties generatedAtUtc -- when the emitted code being sliced was actually produced.

generatorCommit.description: generated-app only: the platform commit BuildInfoEmitter resolved at generation time (may be UNKNOWN if the generator wasn't run from inside a resolvable git checkout).

newestTemplateCommit.description: generated-app only, EXCLUDED from manifestSha256 (a moving target, not a property of the sliced content): the newest platform commit touching the generator templates/emitters, as of when this pack was built.

newestTemplateCommitAt.description: generated-app only, EXCLUDED from manifestSha256: ISO-8601 timestamp of newestTemplateCommit.

stale.description: generated-app only: true when generatedAtUtc predates newestTemplateCommitAt -- REG-51's exact check. The builder refuses to write a pack when this is true; it should never appear as true in a written pack, only in the refusal error.

provenanceVerified.description: generated-app only: whether staleness could actually be checked (both generatedAtUtc and template history were available).

provenanceNote.description: generated-app only: set when provenanceVerified is false, explaining what was missing.

redactionPolicyVersion.description: Version identifier of the single redaction rule source (the EventRedactionPolicy / ExecutionRedactionPolicy / TraceRedactionPolicy family) this pack was built against -- never a policy independently derived for this feature.

sanitizer.description: Result of the hard-fail secret-pattern sweep. A pack whose secretHitCount is nonzero must never be produced; this field is the evidence that the sweep ran, not a substitute for failing the build.

chunks.description: Deterministic chunker output. Re-running the builder on the same input must reproduce identical chunk hashes (P2's 'second build -> identical hash' requirement).

sha256.description: sha256 of this chunk's own text field -- content-addressed, so a tampered or truncated chunk is self-evident.

label.description: Curator-facing description of the chunk's content (e.g. a redacted path or concept name), never raw sensitive data.

text.description: The actual redacted, sanitized chunk content -- what the vendor is sent and what a human reviews before that send (honesty rule 6: the pack must be reviewable before it is sent, which requires it to carry real content, not just hashes).

manifestSha256.description: Hash over the chunk MANIFEST (chunkId + sha256 + lineCount + label for every chunk, plus missionId/source/redactionPolicyVersion) -- deliberately excluding generatedAt (wall-clock) so two builds of identical input hash identically (P2's 'second build -> identical hash' requirement). What a verdict and a run record both reference to prove which exact pack they are about.

budgetLines.description: Total line count across chunks, checked against the pack builder's budget (curated slices, not whole-repo dumps).

shown.description: What the reviewer was shown, in curator-facing terms. Mirrors the mission's packContents; restated here because the pack is the thing actually sent, not just what the mission profile declared.

notShown.description: What the reviewer was deliberately not shown (honesty rule 4 -- pack curation is a declared limitation, not an implicit one).
